SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalRecords, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS totalUsers, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS normalCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN late_minutes > 0 OR status IN ('IN_PROGRESS_LATE', 'LATE', 'LATE_AND_EARLY_LEAVE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lateCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN early_leave_minutes > 0 OR status IN ('EARLY_LEAVE', 'LATE_AND_EARLY_LEAVE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS earlyLeaveCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'MISSING_CHECK_OUT' OR (work_date < #{today} AND check_in_time IS NOT NULL AND check_out_time IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS missingCheckOutCount FROM attendance_record WHERE work_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND user_id = #{userId}
